messages:
Sam: heads up  small but noisy outage in quota dashboards this morning. looks like attrib mismatch from different client libs
Talia: what mismatch?
Sam: TS client started sending `route_tags: \"prod:search\"` (string), python and go send `route_tags: [\"prod:search\"]` (array)
Ravi: that will fragment telemetry. console indexing treats string as a single literal and array as multiple tags -> counts split
Mona: short term we can add an ingest normalizer to convert string->array and tag events with `sdk_shape_migration:inflight`
Sam: agree. also need SDK owners to ship a fix so all libs emit the array form consistently
Talia: i'm the TS owner. i'll push a patch that serializes single tag strings into [tag] and emits a one-time WARN in logs when it sees the old form
Ravi: console: can you add a temporary rollup that merges both shapes so dashboards don't show discontinuities? and surface a `shape_variant` metric by client version
Mona: infra-bot, can we canary the normalizer for 5% at 13:00 PT today?
infra-bot: deploy queued: ingest-normalizer-canary -> 2026-03-22 13:00 PT, 5% traffic, id: deploy-49612-canary
Talia: TS PR ready. tests included for single string, array, and mixed batch. target minor release tomorrow
Sam: go owner?
Ravi: i'll ping platform-libs; likely a tiny change there too. plan: normalize at client before send + integration test hitting shim
Mona: console folks, i'll add the merged rollup tile and leave the migration metric for 14 days
Sam: let's keep this communication light in release notes: "SDKs standardize route_tags serialization to improve quota attribution". include code snippets in #devex
Talia: ack. opening a short thread in #devex after canary success with upgrade guidance
Sam: thanks. reconvene here after canary and when TS/Go releases land."
